levels.description:
Grants Hibernation to the caster for 5s. The caster becomes immune to damage and status effects while Hibernation is active.
Using [Remove Hibernation] while Hibernation is active immediately removes the effect, restores 20% Max HP, and moves the caster backward.

Cannot block certain powerful attacks and is unaffected by cooldown increase effects.
